Proposed: Mainz
research:
The archival abstract names Hermann scholaster of St. Maria ad gradus among Archbishop Dietrich’s tax commissioners. His office and contemporaneous colleagues connect him with the same scholaster in 1449-03-29.json and 1457-04-30.json. Bauer (bauer_1872.json) could not place the 1452 scholaster and vicar general in the Franken genealogy and considered non-noble origin possible. The Mainz patrician family is another possibility, but no kinship links him to it. His Mainz office and surname alone do not distinguish either family. The 1449 archiepiscopal register corroborates his office and colleagues: https://www.ingrossaturbuecher.de/index.php?cHash=346098438fe451949fb23ed021a533c4&id=380&tx_hisodat_sources%5Baction%5D=show&tx_hisodat_sources%5Bcontroller%5D=Sources&tx_hisodat_sources%5Bsource%5D=22092. Attribution unresolved.

Further research supports Mainz. F. W. E. Roth, Archiv für katholisches Kirchenrecht 80 (1900), pp. 189–192, identifies the Mariengreden scholaster and later vicar general as a member of the Mainz patrician Rosenberg family (https://archive.org/details/ArchivFuerKatholischesKirchenrecht1900/page/n191/mode/1up). The Easter 1425 Erfurt matriculation groups Iacobus and Hermanus Rosenberg as de Maguncia (Weissenborn I, p. 131, https://archive.org/details/11698564bsb/page/n162/mode/1up). The Repertorium Academicum Germanicum identifies the jurist as a Mainz patrician (https://resource.database.rag-online.org/ngLB2O476LT2xahbfLkaw). His precise relationship to the family of Jeckel Rosenberg and Elisabeth documented by Ochs (J133, n. 2, https://www.regionalgeschichte.net/fileadmin/Superportal/Bibliothek/Autoren/Ochs/gl71_ochs_personenkataloge.pdf) remains open.

entries.german: Erzbischof Dierich von Mainz legt dem Clerus seiner Diözese eine Steuer von zwei großen Hilfen und sechs Procurationen auf und ernennt Conrad Ruwe d. A. und Heinrich v. Merle Domherrn, Herman v. Rosenberg Scholaster von S. Maria ad gradus, Magister Sander v. Martheshusen Kanonikus von St. Peter zu Kommissaren.
entries.english: Archbishop Dietrich of Mainz imposes on the clergy of his diocese a tax of two great aids and six procurations, and appoints Conrad Ruwe the Elder and Heinrich von Merle, canons, Herman von Rosenberg, Scholaster of S. Maria ad gradus, Magister Sander von Martheshusen, canon of St. Peter, as commissioners.

personTitle: Scholaster von St. Maria ad gradus
facts.content: was appointed commissioner by Archbishop Dietrich of Mainz for a tax imposed on the clergy of his diocese.
